sentences.text: The petitioner is before this Court calling in question proceedings in C.C.No.7144/2019, pending before the XXX Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bengaluru, for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323 and 34 of the IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel for the petitioner and respondent No.2 in unison would submit that the parties to the lis were before the family Court in M.C.No.1570/2018 and during the pendency of the matter before the family Court, they have settled the dispute amicably among themselves before the mediation center by entering into memorandum of settlement.
Based upon the memorandum of agreement, they have parted their NC: 2024:KHC:51601 ways after obtaining the decree of divorce from the concerned Court.
The memorandum of agreement also recognizes the closure of the present proceedings.
An affidavit of the complainant is also filed before this Court to that effect.

3. The affidavit of respondent No.2 reads as follows:
"2. I state that I have filed a complaint before Respondent no. 1 i.e., Kumaraswamy Layout Police Station against the petitioner which was pending for trial in C.C. No.
7144/2019 pending on the file of Hon'ble XXX Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate at Bengaluru the offences punishable under Section 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act and Sections 34, 498-A, 323 of Indian Penal Code.
3. I state that I have also filed a petition against the petitioner seeking decree of divorce in M.C. No. 1570/2018 on the file of Hon'ble I Additional Principal Judge Family Court at Bengaluru in M.C. No. 1570/2018.

6. I state that in view of the settlement arrived between me and the petitioner, I have no objections to quash the further proceedings C.C. No. 7144/2019 pending on the file of Hon'ble XXX Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate at NC: 2024:KHC:51601 Bengaluru the offences punishable under Section 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act and Sections 34, 498-A, 323 of Indian Penal Code, filed against the petitioner.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate at NC: 2024:KHC:51601 Bengaluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 7. I have filed this affidavit voluntarily without coercion or undue influence."

In the light of the afore-quoted affidavit of the complainant - wife, since the dispute is between the husband and wife and have parted their ways, I deem it appropriate to accept the affidavit and terminate the proceedings against the petitioner as the allegations are not against the State.

4. For the aforesaid reasons, I pass the following:
ORDER (i) The criminal petition is disposed.
(ii) The proceedings in C.C.No.7144/2019, pending before the XXX Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bengaluru, stand quashed.
